newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Nations leading $325 mln loan for On Command.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Nations leading $325 mln loan for On Command.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 19 (LPC) - NationsBank Corp has won the mandate to lead a $325 million bank loan partially backing On Command Video's acquisition of pay-per-view movie concern SpectraVision Inc, banking sources said.
SpectraVision has been operating in bankruptcy since June 8, 1995, banking sources added.
Of the bank financing, a $200 million, three-year credit will be syndicated for Ascent Entertainment Group Inc, owner of On Command, bankers added.
In addition, a $125 million, five-year deal will be syndicated for On Command Video, to be called On Command Corp after the acquisition, bankers said.
The deal will replace a $175 million credit put in place by Chase Manhattan Corp in December 1995, a banker added.
